findings.cause: Current guides retained pending integration wording after native acceptance, and conflated key IPC frames with launcher/supervisor limits.
findings.fix: Link completed A/B/C acceptance; distinguish publication/installed support; specify 128KiB key frames, 16MiB input frames and separately bounded supervisor JSON reads.
findings.verification: Current source constants/readers and local document links checked; no production behavior change.

limits: Same UID/SID malicious apps, already delivered app env, arbitrary app files/network and full historical rollback without an external anchor remain outside the accepted guarantee.
Native headless/ad-hoc signing, actual hosted runners/SMB loopback and real WSL restart are distinguished from production signing, physical PCs/LAN, power loss and forced kernel PID recycling.
Scope covers repository changes and dependency usage; no separate audit of third-party library internals or claim of all possible vulnerability absence.
